items.title: Pushforward of a principal divisor along a dominant proper morphism equals the divisor of the norm
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the pushforward of the divisor of a rational function along a dominant proper morphism between integral schemes of the same dimension as the divisor of the norm of that function (statement lines 2644-2656, tag 02RT). The proof reduces to comparing coefficients at an integral closed subscheme of codimension one, uses the codimension one finiteness statement to make the morphism finite over an affine neighbourhood, rewrites both coefficients in ring theoretic terms as an order and as a sum of residue degrees times orders, and concludes with the norm compatibility statement for finite extensions of dimension one. The reduction to the finite case is the substance, so the claim is H2.
